data.description: Named after the twisting curve along its roof, the DNA Pergola is a walk-through garden structure. Wooden posts stand in two rows, and dark steel beams rise and fall in a wave above them, carrying wooden cross-slats that throw striped shade on the path below. It can run along a walkway, link a gate to a clubhouse or cover the route from a parking area to a play zone. For builders finishing an entrance garden, it gives the approach a clear shape. The DNA Pergola belongs to our CoreCraft garden decor range, and Sand Beige is the listed colour. Design customisation is available on request, so share your path measurements and we will send a layout drawing and a quote with warranty terms.

items.pText: Named after the twisting curve along its roof, the DNA Pergola is a walk-through garden structure. Wooden posts stand in two rows, and dark steel beams rise and fall in a wave above them, carrying wooden cross-slats that throw striped shade on the path below. It can run along a walkway, link a gate to a clubhouse or cover the route from a parking area to a play zone. For builders finishing an entrance garden, it gives the approach a clear shape. The DNA Pergola belongs to our CoreCraft garden decor range, and Sand Beige is the listed colour. Design customisation is available on request, so share your path measurements and we will send a layout drawing and a quote with warranty terms.

The posts carry the whole roof, so each one is grouted into a footing or bolted to a firm slab, depending on the ground we find. Climbing plants can be trained up the posts, but keep them trimmed off the slats so rainwater drains. Check the beam joints and slat screws every year, and recoat exposed wood when the finish dulls.
